blurb: McIntosh Lake is a reservoir that is part of a statewide ditch and reservoir system with water levels dependent on weather and system priorities. The area allows carry-on, non-motorized boats such as canoes, kayaks, paddleboards, and small boats. The park includes a 3.5-mile trail loop around the lake and picnic areas.
extraNote: Lake hours are 1 hour before sunrise until 1 hour after sunset · Swimming is prohibited · Dogs must be on a leash at all times · No glass containers · Access to lake is only at the designated boat ramps
